sources.note: Found by web search on 5 Oct 2026 and opened the same day. Not from a feed. The page is rendered by script; the text was read from the page source.

claims.claim: Eurogamer published a piece headlined: GTA 6 completely "re-engineered" Rockstar's weather systems to "achieve a sense of scale we haven't felt before," adding hurricanes, rainbows and heavy rain
claims.evidence: If you thought Red Dead Redemption 2 's heavy winds and even heavier rain looked impressive, you might be happy to learn that Rockstar Games went back and "re-engineered our weather system" for GTA 6 . Hurricanes, rainbows and "vertiginous cumulonimbus clouds" are all part of the upcoming open worlder. Read more

claims.claim: Rock Paper Shotgun published a piece headlined: GTA 6 will simulate hurricanes, rainbows and persistent, dynamic clouds, among other efforts to make you stop doing crime and become a weather nerd
claims.evidence: Grand Theft Auto 6 features a re-engineered, "more localized and persistent" weather system that ranges in intensity from physically credible rainbows to full-bore hurricanes, according to Rockstar vice president of art for lighting and rendering Owen Shepherd. claims.claim: Eurogamer reports that, in the Game Informer feature, the studio said there are over 170 animal species in the world, including 60 different birds and more than 30 land mammals.
claims.evidence: Eurogamer, 30 Sep 2026, final paragraph. Opened 5 Oct 2026.

claims.claim: Eurogamer reports that underwater scuba-diving returns, with manatees, jellyfish and whales, and that the game has discoverable animals the player can study and Legendary animals the studio is keeping quiet about.
claims.evidence: Eurogamer, 30 Sep 2026, final paragraph. Opened 5 Oct 2026.

claims.claim: Rock Paper Shotgun, citing the Game Informer write-up, lists manatees, flamingos, pelicans, sharks, rays, turtles and jellyfish among the 170 species.
claims.evidence: Rock Paper Shotgun, 30 Sep 2026, paragraph on the menagerie. Opened 5 Oct 2026.

claims.claim: Rockstar's official site describes Grassrivers as a primordial expanse where the gators may be the most famous attraction but there are far deadlier predators and weirder discoveries among the mangroves.
claims.evidence: rockstargames.com/VI/only-in-leonida/grassrivers, region description, read from the page source on 5 Oct 2026. Marketing copy: it describes the place, not a game mechanic.
claims.quote: The gators may be the most famous attraction, but there are far deadlier predators and weirder discoveries among the mangroves.

claims.claim: One of the official Grassrivers screenshots on Rockstar's site is described, in its own image description, as a helicopter and two police cars chasing a pick-up truck through a swamp with alligators, with an airboat in the background.
claims.evidence: rockstargames.com/VI/only-in-leonida/grassrivers, alt text of image Grassrivers_04, read from the page source on 5 Oct 2026. It is a still image: it shows the scene, it does not say animals react to the chase.
claims.quote: A helicopter and two police cars chase a pick-up truck through a swamp with alligators in the Grassrivers.

claims.claim: Rockstar's official site says Mount Kalaga, on the state's northern border, offers prime hunting, fishing and off-road trails.
claims.evidence: rockstargames.com/VI/only-in-leonida, Mount Kalaga description, read from the page source on 5 Oct 2026.
claims.quote: Mount Kalaga offers prime hunting, fishing, and off-road trails.
